view.scene_description: A brightly lit supermarket aisle with colorful hanging decorations, including hot air balloon and red lantern ornaments. Shelves are stocked with various products, and customers browse items. A refrigerated section is visible in the background, along with promotional posters and signage. The ceiling has fluorescent lights and exposed structural elements.

objects.label: man wearing white shirt
objects.observation: A man in a white long-sleeved shirt with Chinese characters on it stands near shelves, holding a product. He wears glasses and looks down at items. His position is left-center of the frame, partially obscured by stacked boxes. He is standing on the floor, supported by his feet.

objects.label: woman with dark hair
objects.observation: A woman with dark hair is partially visible behind the man, looking toward the shelves. She is positioned slightly to the right of the man and appears to be browsing. Her face is mostly obscured by the man’s shoulder and the shelving unit.

objects.label: stacked product boxes
objects.observation: Tall stacks of colorful product boxes in pink, green, blue, and white are arranged on the left side of the aisle. They are placed directly on the floor, forming a display. Some boxes have visible branding like 'Cidron'.

objects.label: fruit display
objects.observation: A fruit display with purple grapes and other produce sits on a wooden counter in the center-right of the aisle. It is positioned in front of a refrigerated section and is supported by the counter surface. The display is partially covered by a plastic sheet.

objects.label: hot air balloon decorations
objects.observation: Several decorative hot air balloons hang from the ceiling. One is red and white striped, another is blue and white striped, and others are yellow and white. They are suspended by thin wires and appear to float above the aisle, adding festive ambiance.

objects.label: red lanterns
objects.observation: Red paper lanterns hang from the ceiling in clusters, positioned between the hot air balloon decorations. They are spherical and appear to be made of paper or fabric, providing a festive touch to the store's decor.

objects.label: fluorescent lighting fixtures
objects.observation: Multiple rectangular fluorescent light fixtures are mounted to the black ceiling, illuminating the aisle. They are evenly spaced and provide bright, even lighting across the store. Some fixtures are partially obscured by decorations.

objects.label: refrigerated display case
objects.observation: A refrigerated display case with glass doors is located in the background, near the right wall. It contains various beverages and food items. A person is standing beside it, facing away from the camera. The case is supported by its base and integrated into the store layout.

objects.label: person in dark clothing
objects.observation: A person wearing dark clothing, including a hoodie and pants, stands near the refrigerated display case. Their back is to the camera, and they appear to be examining items inside the case. They are standing on the floor, supported by their feet.

objects.label: promotional poster
objects.observation: A large promotional poster is visible on the right wall, featuring an image of a young man and Chinese text. It is mounted on the wall and partially obstructed by a shelf. The poster is likely advertising a product or sale.

objects.label: shelving units
objects.observation: Metal shelving units line both sides of the aisle, filled with various products. The shelves are supported by metal frames and extend from the floor to the ceiling. Some shelves have wire baskets attached for additional storage.

<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_dense_test50/image-000006", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
